notes: «ح» and «وحدثناه» give two routes that repeat Hammad and Ma'bad, so they are two groups; the text writes Anas once after them, so he is the shared tail (rule 3). «- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.
«وتشفعنا بثابت» and «فاستأذن لنا ثابت» place Thabit in the scene, so he is not a link (rule 6).

Third group, rule 11: after the saying the report gives a second isnad («فأشهد على الحسن أنه حدثنا به أنه سمع أنس») with its own witness; the speaker who bears witness is not named, so whether it joins the chain is left for a ruling. Needs_ruling is set for the report.
The first «الحسن» in «إلى الحسن» is the place they went, not a link.
